cues.en: So, yeah, you know, definitely,
cues.zh: 所以，嗯，你知道，确实如此，

cues.en: know, doubt... Remember, the rule on open source software is in exchange in exchange for not having to pay a license fee, you become part of the development community. So play with play with pre release software to make sure... See if it works.
cues.zh: 你知道，别怀疑……记住，开源软件的规则是：作为不用支付许可费的交换，你会成为开发社区的一员。所以试试试用版软件，确保……看看它能不能用。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: so, okay, you've downloaded and installed Postgres, and now you wanna get going. So you need to create a database cluster.
cues.zh: 好，现在你已经下载并安装了 PostgreSQL，接下来想开始用了。你需要创建一个数据库集群。

cues.en: This is an unfortunate piece of Postgres terminology, and for people new to Postgres, it can be pretty confusing.
cues.zh: 这是 Postgres 术语中一个不太妥当的地方，对 Postgres 新手来说可能会相当困惑。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: a single server, that is to say a single, you know, Linux process with its child processes and all that, can manage multiple databases.
cues.zh: 单个服务器，也就是说单个 Linux 进程加上它的子进程等等，可以管理多个数据库。

cues.en: A single... A a Postgres database is a nearly completely autonomous set of database objects, like tables and indexes and things like that. You can't join between them. You can't do thing... You can't do any specific operations between them, but one server can have any number of them.
cues.zh: 一个……一个 Postgres 数据库是一组几乎完全自治的数据库对象，比如表和索引之类的。你不能在它们之间做关联查询。你不能做……不能在它们之间做任何特定操作，但一台服务器上可以有任意数量的数据库。

cues.en: That the... For that reason,
cues.zh: 所以……正因如此，

cues.en: Postgres calls that kind of... That complete group of things a cluster. So you'll see in the documentation that you create a cluster and start the cluster and do that kind of thing.
cues.zh: Postgres 把这类……把这一整组东西称为集群。所以你会在文档里看到，你要创建集群、启动集群之类的操作。

cues.en: This is revealing kind of Postgres' night... Early... Late nineties
cues.zh: 这其实暴露了 Postgres 的……早期……九十年代末

cues.en: orientation
cues.zh: 定位

cues.en: that it calls this single server thing a cluster.
cues.zh: 它把这单个服务器称为集群。

cues.en: I'm gonna use that term because that's what the docs
cues.zh: 我会沿用这个说法，因为文档里

cues.en: use.
cues.zh: 就是这么用的。

cues.en: But now, to most people, cluster involved means multiple machines and multiple database instance, you know, multiple server instances and things like that. That's not the way Postgres uses that term.
cues.zh: 但如今在大多数人看来，集群意味着多台机器、多个数据库实例，你知道，多个服务器实例之类的。Postgres 并不是这么用这个词的。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: to... Just understand that when you're reading the documentation and hearing me talk.
cues.zh: ……你只要在阅读文档和听我讲的时候理解这一点就好。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: I'll use the term cluster, but just remember it means a single server instance. It's a single program,
cues.zh: 我会用“集群”这个词，但请记住它指的只是单个服务器实例，是一个单独的程序，

cues.en: you know, single Linux process or Windows process plus all its children
cues.zh: 你知道，单个 Linux 进程或 Windows 进程加上它的所有子进程

cues.en: running.
cues.zh: 运行中。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Ultimately,
cues.zh: 归根结底，

cues.en: the program you use on on on...
cues.zh: 你用的那个程序……

cues.en: For Postgres is this program in NitDB,
cues.zh: 针对 Postgres 则是 NitDB 中的这个程序，

cues.en: which creates a cluster. So already with the confu... We're getting confused because it's called a NitDB and it creates a cluster.
cues.zh: 这就创建了一个集群。所以光是 confu……我们搞混了，因为它叫 NitDB，却创建了一个集群。它创建了一个集群。所以光是 confu……我们搞混了，因为它叫 NitDB，却创建了一个集群。

cues.en: Oh, well.
cues.zh: 哦，好吧。

cues.en: It's... It... This is the... Fortunately, we're all Linux... You know, most of us have Unix Unix of some variety experience, so cryptic command... Cryptic and meaningless command names are part of the deal.
cues.zh: 这……这……这就是……幸好我们都是 Linux 用户……你知道，我们大多数人都用过某种 Unix，所以晦涩难懂、毫无意义的命令名也是家常便饭。

cues.en: What it does is
cues.zh: 它的作用是

cues.en: creates a bunch of files in the file system.
cues.zh: 在文件系统里创建一堆文件。

cues.en: A Postgres cluster
cues.zh: 一个 Postgres 集群

cues.en: and the databases that make it up are just files.
cues.zh: 以及组成它的数据库，都只是一些文件。

cues.en: There's nothing magic about them.
cues.zh: 它们没什么神奇的。

cues.en: It doesn't it doesn't do anything else except lay out a files... A a file system tree.
cues.zh: 它除了铺设一个文件系统……一个文件系统目录树之外，什么也不做。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: you can have a bunch of different clusters on the same machine at different...
cues.zh: 你可以在同一台机器上的不同……

cues.en: Inside different directories.
cues.zh: 在不同的目录里运行多个不同的集群。

cues.en: There's nothing magic about it.
cues.zh: 这没什么玄妙的。

cues.en: By itself, it doesn't start the server... The underlying server process to manage the cluster. It just lays out the files, tells you it's done.
cues.zh: 它本身并不会启动服务器……不会启动底层管理集群的服务器进程。它只是布置好文件，然后提示你搞定了。

cues.en: Many packaging systems, and by many, I mean specifically the Debian flavor, will automatically start the cluster for you, which is a little bit of a surprise if you weren't expecting it.
cues.zh: 很多打包系统，我具体是指 Debian 这一系的，会自动帮你启动集群，如果你没心理准备的话，可能会有点意外。

cues.en: The Debian flavor packaging provides its own set of commands. There's a p g underscore create cluster command
cues.zh: Debian 风格的打包提供了自己的一套命令。有一个 pg_ctlcluster 命令

cues.en: that wraps in it DB.
cues.zh: 它封装了 initdb。

cues.en: And that automatic... And and that will automatically fire up the server for you, which is a little surprise. Installing Postgres automatically fires up the server for you, which is interesting.
cues.zh: 它会自动为你启动服务器，这有点出乎意料。安装 Postgres 会自动启动服务器，挺有意思的。

cues.en: I like the Debian style packaging.
cues.zh: 我喜欢 Debian 风格的打包。

cues.en: One of the nice parts about it is it has this cluster management system, so it makes it easy to run multiple versions of Postgres or multiple clusters
cues.zh: 它的优点之一是自带集群管理系统，因此可以轻松运行多个版本的 Postgres，或者在同一系统上运行同一版本的多个集群。

cues.en: of the same version on the same system.
cues.zh: 同一版本的多个集群。

cues.en: If you are running on a Debian Flavor
cues.zh: 如果你用的是 Debian 系发行版

cues.en: system like Ubuntu,
cues.zh: 像 Ubuntu 这样的系统，

cues.en: use these. They'll make your life a lot easier.
cues.zh: 用上这些，你的生活会轻松很多。

cues.en: So you use p g underscore create cluster instead of init d b.
cues.zh: 所以你应该用 pg_createcluster，而不是 initdb。

cues.en: So when you're creating this, always create databases as UTF eight. What I mean that is that their their
cues.zh: 所以创建数据库时，始终使用UTF-8编码。我的意思是，它们的

cues.en: default character encoding is UTF eight.
cues.zh: 默认字符编码是 UTF-8。

cues.en: Once you've create... This is per database, not for the entire cluster, but for each individual database inside the cluster.
cues.zh: 一旦你创建……这是针对单个数据库的，不是针对整个集群，而是针对集群内的每个单独数据库。

cues.en: Once you've created
cues.zh: 创建之后

cues.en: a database, you can't change its character encoding. And then you get one character encoding per database. You can't have one table that's UTF eight, one table that's Latin one,
cues.zh: 数据库的字符编码就不能再改了。每个数据库只能用一种字符编码。不能一张表用 UTF-8，另一张表用 Latin-1，

cues.en: or something like that.
cues.zh: 诸如此类。

cues.en: The problem is converting from SQL ASCII or really from any other character encoding to UTF-eight
cues.zh: 从 SQL ASCII 转换成 UTF-8，或者从任何其他字符编码转换成 UTF-8，

cues.en: can be a nightmare.
cues.zh: 都可能让人头疼不已。

cues.en: SQL ASCII is a
cues.zh: SQL ASCII 是一种

cues.en: character encoding that's not a character encoding. It's a... This is just a random string of bytes. Hope you know what the character encoding is.
cues.zh: 名义上是字符编码、实际上却不是的编码。它……这只是一串随机字节。希望你知道它用的是什么字符编码。

cues.en: Generally, if it didn't create as UTF-eight, it'll have created as SQL ASCII.
cues.zh: 通常来说，如果它没有被创建为 UTF-8，就会被创建成 SQL_ASCII。

cues.en: Make sure you don't do that
cues.zh: 一定要避免这样做

cues.en: Because you will eventually
cues.zh: 因为你迟早会

cues.en: be miserable for for having done so.
cues.zh: 因为这个决定而痛苦不堪。

cues.en: The other thing that that is set once
cues.zh: 另一个在数据库上一旦设定

cues.en: forever on a database is locale.
cues.zh: 就永久生效的是 locale（语言区域）。

cues.en: Locale is
cues.zh: Locale 包括

cues.en: things like the collation rules.
cues.zh: 像排序规则（collation rules）这类东西。

cues.en: Like, do you use English or German or whatever collation rules?
cues.zh: 比如，你是用英语还是德语，或者其他的排序规则？

cues.en: You know, use what you want
cues.zh: 根据你的需求

cues.en: to use, but don't use c locale.
cues.zh: 去选就行，但千万别用 C locale。

cues.en: C locale is what it'll use if it can't figure out the locale. C locale is treat everything as a as a raw byte string
cues.zh: C locale 是在无法确定 locale 时的默认选择。C locale 会把所有内容都当作原始字节串来处理，

cues.en: rather than use local collation rules.
cues.zh: 而不是应用本地的排序规则。

cues.en: By default,
cues.zh: 默认情况下，

cues.en: it uses UTF eight in your system locale, So you should be okay. Just look at the output from init DB or create cluster and make sure it did the right thing.
cues.zh: 它会在系统区域设置中使用 UTF-8，所以应该没问题。只需查看 init DB 或 create cluster 的输出，确保它做对了。

cues.en: In 09/03, a feature was introduced of on disk checksums.
cues.zh: 在 09/03 版本中，引入了一项磁盘校验和功能。

cues.en: These maintain a checksum for each data page.
cues.zh: 它会为每个数据页维护一个校验和。

cues.en: There's a very small performance hit for you... For these, but use them.
cues.zh: 这会对你的性能造成非常小的影响……但对于这些，还是要用。

cues.en: Because any hard drive is going to have a handful of unchecked
cues.zh: 因为任何硬盘都会有一些未检查的

cues.en: uncorrected data errors on it. Any real life hard drive.
cues.zh: 未纠正的数据错误。任何现实生活中的硬盘都是如此。

cues.en: This will help you spot those.
cues.zh: 这能帮你找出它们。

cues.en: It it... If it reads a page off a disk and the check sum's wrong, it'll throw an error.
cues.zh: 它……如果它从磁盘读取一个页面，而校验和出错，它就会抛出错误。

cues.en: Doesn't fix the problem, but at least you know it exists.
cues.zh: 虽然没解决问题，但至少你知道它存在。

cues.en: It's an option on init d b. The default is no check sums, which is why I'm bringing it up.
cues.zh: 这是 initdb 的一个选项，默认不启用校验和，这也是我专门提出来的原因。

cues.en: If you're using the Debian packaging,
cues.zh: 如果你用的是 Debian 打包方式，

cues.en: you can either specify it in the create cluster command line or you by default... To make it a default, there's etcetera post underscore common create cluster dot conf. You can add options to pass to init d b. So here's what it kinda looks like.
cues.zh: 你可以在 create cluster 命令行里指定它，也可以使用默认配置……要设为默认值，可以在 etcetera post underscore common create cluster dot conf 里配置。你可以添加传给 init d b 的选项。大概就是这样。

cues.en: You say, init db uppercase d, that points it to the directory that you're gonna lay out all these files in. The dash k option means checksums.
cues.zh: 你输入 init db，大写 D，这会指定你要把所有这些文件放在哪个目录里。-k 选项表示使用校验和。

cues.en: Uppercase e is what encoding to use, and dash dash locale equals is what locale to use.
cues.zh: 大写 E 指定使用哪种编码，--locale= 指定使用哪种区域设置。

cues.en: So rolling it all together, that's what it kind of looks like. If you're using create cluster,
cues.zh: 把这些合在一起，大致就是这样。如果你用 create cluster，

cues.en: it looks kind of like this. If you
cues.zh: 看起来大概是这样。如果你

cues.en: specify
cues.zh: 指定

cues.en: 9.5 in main, the 9.5 is which version, and main is
cues.zh: 9.5 in main，9.5 表示版本，main 则是

cues.en: just the name of a cluster within that version. So you can have a bunch of different clusters inside that are running 9.5.
cues.zh: 这个版本下集群的名称。所以你可以在里面建多个运行 9.5 的集群。

cues.en: And again, d is the directory,
cues.zh: 再强调一下，-d 是目录，

cues.en: encoding locale,
cues.zh: 指定编码和区域设置，

cues.en: then you put a double dash that says pass the rest of this to init d b unchanged,
cues.zh: 然后加上两个横杠 --，表示把后面的参数原样传给 initdb，

cues.en: and dash k is
cues.zh: 而 -k 代表

cues.en: checksums.
cues.zh: 校验和（checksums）。

cues.en: A few other important things. When you're setting this up, create a separate database volume and partition for data. If you're running for a server,
cues.zh: 还有几点很重要。配置的时候，要为数据单独建一个数据库卷和分区。如果是跑在服务器上，

cues.en: on your laptop, who cares? But on a on a on a production server.
cues.zh: 笔记本上就无所谓了，但要是生产服务器，

cues.en: You want that... You want... You don't wanna create it on root because roots fill up and you... It's kind of embarrassing to run out of space on your database volume.
cues.zh: 你最好……别建在根分区上，因为根分区很容易被占满，要是数据库卷的空间耗尽了，那就很尴尬了。

cues.en: Don't... This is...
cues.zh: 别……这是……

cues.en: I I I didn't think about putting this in until I saw a bunch of
cues.zh: 我，我，我本来没想把这个放进去，直到我看到一堆

cues.en: bunch of clients do it.
cues.zh: 一堆客户这么做了。

cues.en: When you're creating the mount point for this volume, don't put the version number in the mount point. Just say slash data, and then have a directory inside of it to have the version number. It's... Having the version number in the path is very useful, so you can easily separate multiple versions. But don't bake that in because then it's permanent.
cues.zh: 你在为这个卷创建挂载点时，别把版本号放进挂载点。就写 /data，然后在里面建个目录来放版本号。这样……把版本号放在路径里很有用，这样可以轻松区分多个版本。但别把它固化进去，因为那样就永久了。

cues.en: The reason this is a problem is if you do an upgrade,
cues.zh: 这个问题之所以麻烦，是因为如果你做一次升级，

cues.en: where are you going to put that new upgraded thing? You can create a new volume, of course. Or you can say, now I'm gonna put in data slash nine dot five slash 9 dot 6.
cues.zh: 你打算把升级后的新东西放在哪儿？当然，你可以新建一个卷。或者你可以说，现在我要放到 data/9.5/9.6 里。

cues.en: And, you know, we're professionals. Don't do that.
cues.zh: 而且，你知道，我们都是专业人士。别那么干。

cues.en: When you create these things, use either EXT four or XFS for the file system.
cues.zh: 创建这些的时候，文件系统请用 EXT4 或 XFS。

cues.en: If you are comfortable tuning ZFS,
cues.zh: 如果你对调优 ZFS 很有把握，

cues.en: use ZFS.
cues.zh: 那就用 ZFS。

cues.en: But ZFS has a lot of knobs and dials and switches on it to be tuned, and you need to fully understand how these work because you can get really terrible performance on ZFS if it's not set up correctly.
cues.zh: 但 ZFS 上有大量的旋钮、拨盘和开关需要调优，你需要完全理解它们的工作原理，因为如果配置不当，ZFS 的性能会非常糟糕。

cues.en: If you're not interested in in becoming a ZFS guru,
cues.zh: 如果你不想成为 ZFS 专家，

cues.en: just use the XT four or XFS. There's really no strong difference between those. EXT four's overall
cues.zh: 就用 EXT4 或 XFS。它们之间其实没什么明显区别。EXT4 的整体

cues.en: average performance is a tiny bit higher,
cues.zh: 平均性能稍微高一点，

cues.en: but it's very... It's much more variable than XFS. XFS's
cues.zh: 但它……波动比 XFS 大得多。XFS 的

cues.en: average performance is slightly lower than EXT four, but it's... But but you don't get the spikes upward or downward
cues.zh: 平均性能比 EXT4 略低，但它……但它不会像 EXT4 那样，性能忽高忽低，

cues.en: that you do on EXT four. So...
cues.zh: 所以……

cues.en: But I wouldn't, like, rebuild a two terabyte database just because I was on one instead of the other. You know? It's not that big a deal.
cues.zh: 不过，我不会只因为用了其中一个而不是另一个，就重建一个两 TB 的数据库。你懂吧？没那么要紧。

cues.en: But don't use EXT three.
cues.zh: 但千万别用 ext3。

cues.en: And there are exotic file systems
cues.zh: 还有一些小众的文件系统，

cues.en: like,
cues.zh: 比如……

cues.en: you know, don't use RiserFS.
cues.zh: 你懂的，别用 ReiserFS。

cues.en: Don't... You know, all... There are lots of other exotic file systems. They don't offer a significant performance advantage and often a significant performance hit compared to those guys. This is not an area that you need to be bleeding edge.
cues.zh: 别……总之，还有很多其他小众的文件系统。相比这几个主流的，它们并没有明显的性能优势，反而经常导致严重的性能下降。在这方面真没必要去追求前沿技术。

cues.en: Okay. Now we've laid out all these files. It's... The binaries are there, and we'd like to do database things, finally.
cues.zh: 好了，现在这些文件都规划好了，二进制文件也到位了，我们终于可以做点数据库相关的正事了。

cues.en: The program that you need to get really familiar with, which is installed as part of Postgres in any packaging,
cues.zh: 你需要非常熟悉的这个程序，在任何打包方式安装的 Postgres 中都会附带，

cues.en: is called p g underscore c t l,
cues.zh: 它叫 p g 下划线 c t l，

cues.en: which is what you use to control Postgres. It's a built in command, and it starts and stops Postgres.
cues.zh: 你就是用它来控制 Postgres 的。它是一个内置命令，用来启动和停止 Postgres。

cues.en: And does a few other maintenance things, like it'll reload the... Like, you can signal Postgres to reload the configure... Its configuration file.
cues.zh: 还能做一些其他的维护工作，比如重新加载……你可以给 Postgres 发信号，让它重新加载配置……它的配置文件。

cues.en: Frequently,
cues.zh: 常见的有，

cues.en: init d,
cues.zh: init d，

cues.en: upstart, system d, all these guys,
cues.zh: upstart、system d，所有这些，

cues.en: these are all wrappers around p g underscore c t l to to control Postgres.
cues.zh: 它们其实都是对 p g 下划线 c t l 的封装，用来控制 Postgres。

cues.en: Again,
cues.zh: 再说一遍，

cues.en: because Debian has this cluster management system layered
cues.zh: 因为 Debian 在它上面加了一套集群管理系统，

cues.en: on top of it, it provides its own scripts to
cues.zh: 还提供了自己的脚本来

cues.en: manage this stuff that are wrappers around pgctl.
cues.zh: 管理这些东西，这些脚本其实是 pgctl 的封装。

cues.en: Just use those instead.
cues.zh: 用这些脚本就行。

cues.en: So before we talk about... So we've started it, and now we wanna stop it for some reason.
cues.zh: 在我们讨论……我们已经启动了它，现在因为某种原因想把它停下来。

cues.en: We... One thing to remember about stopping Postgres is there are three different modes for stopping Postgres.
cues.zh: 我们……关于停止 Postgres，有一点要记住：停止 Postgres 有三种不同的模式。

cues.en: They're called smart, fast, and immediate.
cues.zh: 它们叫作 smart、fast 和 immediate。

cues.en: If you're using p g CTL directly, there's the dash m option.
cues.zh: 如果你直接用 pg_ctl，有个 -m 选项。

cues.en: Smart
cues.zh: smart

cues.en: waits until all clients have disconnected
cues.zh: 会等到所有客户端都断开连接

cues.en: and then completes the system shutdown.
cues.zh: 然后完成系统关闭。

cues.en: So it puts Postgres in shutdown mode, which means no new clients can connect,
cues.zh: 它会让 Postgres 进入关闭模式，也就是说，不再接受新客户端连接，

cues.en: and then waits for everyone to connect on their own, disconnect on their own,
cues.zh: 然后等所有客户端自行断开连接，

cues.en: which means if no one... If the... If somebody's gone to lunch,
cues.zh: 这意味着，如果没人……如果……如果有人出去吃午饭了，

cues.en: if the application is left... Leaves connections open by default
cues.zh: 如果应用默认会一直保持连接打开，

cues.en: or anything like that, it'll wait forever, and now your system's in kind of this weird undefined state.
cues.zh: 或者遇到类似情况，它就会一直等下去，而系统会进入某种奇怪的未定义状态。

cues.en: Generally, you don't want that. What you want is fast,
cues.zh: 通常你不会想要这种方式。你想要的是快速关闭（fast），

cues.en: which cancels all the queries that are running,
cues.zh: 它会取消所有正在运行的查询，

cues.en: breaks all the connections, and then shuts it down. So it kicks everyone off the database then shuts it down cleanly.
cues.zh: 断开所有连接，然后将其关闭。也就是把所有人都踢出数据库，然后干净利落地关机。

cues.en: Sometimes
cues.zh: 但有时候，

cues.en: that doesn't work.
cues.zh: 这招不管用。

cues.en: The query is not cancellable for some reason.
cues.zh: 出于某些原因，查询无法被取消。

cues.en: Something's gotten hung,
cues.zh: 某些东西卡死了，

cues.en: you know, you... And you... But you really wanna take the system down.
cues.zh: 而你……你又必须马上把系统停掉。

cues.en: For that, there's immediate.
cues.zh: 针对这种情况，可以使用立即关闭（immediate）。

cues.en: Immediate... What immediate does is crash Postgres.
cues.zh: Immediate……Immediate 的作用就是让 Postgres 崩溃。

cues.en: And I'm... I... Most people are now thinking, oh my god. Why would I ever wanna do that? But that's okay. Postgres is crash safe.
cues.zh: 而我……我……大多数人现在会想，天哪，我为什么要那么做？但没关系，Postgres 是崩溃安全的。

cues.en: It does mean when Postgres comes up, it has to do a recovery operation,
cues.zh: 这确实意味着 Postgres 启动时必须执行恢复操作，

cues.zh: 这会增加启动所需的时间，我们稍后会讨论这一点。

cues.en: It's perfectly safe,
cues.zh: 这完全安全，

cues.en: but it does require a longer start up.

cues.zh: 偶尔，

cues.zh: 好。你知道吗……显然，现在这已经不是标准做法了。但我做 Oracle 数据库管理员时，他们说你进去第一件事就是创建八个表空间。照做。照做。照做。照做。你知道，他们就那样……一直盯着你，催你创建表空间。

cues.zh: 别这么做

cues.en: Now there is an extra for experts. If you have unusual storage configurations that are getting more and more unusual now, I mean, back in the day, having, like, your little cluster of SSDs plus all of your spinning disks was like a a... Was a not unheard of storage configuration, then tablespaces made sense because you, like, put all the indexes on the SSDs and the data on the spinning disk. Generally, now you get what the cloud provider throws at you, you know, or something like that. Or you just lay... You just combine everything with with software RAID or it's a big SAN or something like that. The... You generally, for that reason,
cues.zh: 接下来讲个进阶内容。如果你有特殊的存储配置——如今这种配置越来越少见了。我是说，以前你有一小组 SSD，再加上一堆机械硬盘，这种存储配置并不罕见。这种情况下，表空间就很有用，因为你可以把所有索引放在 SSD 上，把数据放在机械硬盘上。现在通常是用云服务商提供的存储，或者类似的方案。或者你把所有东西都用软件 RAID 组合起来，或者用一个大型 SAN 之类的。总之，正因为这些原因，你通常……

cues.zh: 所以一般来说，只有确实需要时才用表空间。不要照搬 Oracle 那套做法，动不动就创建一堆表空间，就因为那是 Oracle 的惯例。

cues.en: just three configuration parameters you need to set on the basis of memory. Shared buffers, work mem, and maintenance work mem.

cues.en: When Postgres starts up, it grabs a hunk of memory. It used to be system five shared memory, now it's POSIX shared memory.
cues.zh: Postgres 启动时会占用一大块内存。以前用的是 System V 共享内存，现在用的是 POSIX 共享内存。

cues.en: And shared buffers and it uses this as its basically

cues.zh: 这是主要的缓存，用来把数据保存在内存中

cues.en: for performance purposes.
cues.zh: 以提升性能。

cues.en: It also uses the file system cache, of course, and that's important, very important in Postgres.
cues.zh: 当然，它也会使用文件系统缓存；这在 Postgres 中很重要，非常重要。

cues.en: There's another parameter that you need... That is set on the basis of memory. Now effective cache size isn't an allocation.
cues.zh: 还有一个参数需要……根据内存来设置。effective_cache_size 并不是内存分配。

cues.en: Postgres will never ever try to grab this amount of memory. Know, will never try to malloc
cues.zh: Postgres 绝不会尝试占用这么多内存，也绝不会尝试分配

cues.en: this amount of memory.
cues.zh: 这么多内存。

cues.en: It's a hint to the planner
cues.zh: 这是给规划器的一个提示

cues.en: that says, here's about how much the system can keep in memory versus... At one time.
cues.zh: 告诉它系统一次大概能在内存中保留多少数据。

cues.en: You generally want to set it to the amount of file system cache available.
cues.zh: 通常你会想把它设为可用的文件系统缓存大小。

cues.en: If you don't know, type free dash m and see what the system tells you.
cues.zh: 如果你不知道，可以输入 free -m 看看系统的输出。

cues.en: If you have no way of finding out, like you're on RDS and don't have access to the shell,
cues.zh: 如果你没办法查到，比如用的是 RDS 且没有 shell 权限，

cues.en: 75% have told system memory is about right. RDS is actually sets this to the default on RDS is okay. But if you're on a system where you don't have shell access, for example,
cues.zh: 设为系统总内存的 75% 差不多刚好。RDS 实际上已经把这个……RDS 上的默认值就挺好。但比如你所在的系统没有 shell 权限，

cues.en: but you need to set this, 75% of total system memory is, like, a good estimate.
cues.zh: 同时你又需要设置它，那么系统总内存的 75% 会是一个不错的预估值。

cues.en: And you're done here. Again, this is not a sensitive setting, and you're not going to go... And if you're off by a few gigabyte,
cues.zh: 到这里就完成了。再说一次，这不是敏感设置，你不会……就算差了几 GB，

cues.en: nothing bad will happen to you. And, again, this is not an allocation.
cues.zh: 也不会出什么问题。再说一次，这不是分配。

cues.en: This is a hint to the planner.
cues.zh: 这只是给规划器的一个提示。

cues.en: Questions about memory settings?
cues.zh: 关于内存设置有问题吗？

cues.en: Okay. Next thing you have to do is checkpointing.
cues.zh: 好。接下来你要做的是检查点。

cues.en: Every once in a while, Postgres does a checkpoint, which is... Remember that shared buffers thing? So shared buffers is filling up with stuff,
cues.zh: 每隔一段时间，Postgres 会做一次检查点，也就是……还记得共享缓冲区那回事吗？共享缓冲区不断被填满，

cues.en: some of which are modified database
cues.zh: 其中一些是被修改过的数据库

cues.en: pages.
cues.zh: 页面。

cues.en: You read you know, you've done an update, you did a delete, you did an insert, and there's a database page sitting in shared buffers but it hasn't been written to disk yet that is dirty.
cues.zh: 你读了一条记录，也做了更新、删除和插入。数据库页还在共享缓冲区里，尚未写入磁盘，所以它是脏页。

cues.en: But it needs to be written to disk to have the disk image be consistent.
cues.zh: 但它需要写入磁盘，这样磁盘上的数据才会保持一致。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: once in a while... Postgres does a background process where it's writing these things all the time. But once in a while, it mean... It does a complete flush of everything to disk.
cues.zh: Postgres 会一直通过后台进程把这些内容写入磁盘。不过偶尔，它会把所有内容一次性全部刷写到磁盘。

cues.en: That's called a checkpoint.
cues.zh: 这就叫检查点（checkpoint）。

cues.en: Just like you... Just like that description implies, this could be a lot of IO.
cues.zh: 正如……正如字面意思那样，这可能会产生大量的 I/O。

cues.en: If you have 32 gigabytes,
cues.zh: 如果你有 32 GB 内存，

cues.en: possibly
cues.zh: 可能

cues.en: the int... All 30 of of shared... Or 16 gigabytes of shared buffers, all 16 gigabytes could be dirty, and it could weight a cup and need to cram 16 gigabytes of data onto the disk all at once.
cues.zh: 整……全部 30 个共享……或者 16 GB 的 shared buffers，这 16 GB 可能全都是脏页，它可能突然醒来，需要一口气把 16 GB 的数据全部塞进磁盘。

cues.en: So tuning this can can be important because you don't wanna swamp the IO channel.
cues.zh: 所以调优这个参数非常重要，因为你肯定不想让 I/O 通道被瞬间挤爆。

cues.en: It's... You...
Checkpointing is done when you hit one of two thresholds.
cues.zh: 检查点是在达到两个阈值之一时进行的。

cues.en: A particular number of wall segments have been written. And if you are looking at me going, what is a wall segment? Don't worry about it. You can think of it conceptually as the amount of as the amount of data that's changed in the database so far.
cues.zh: 已写入一定数量的 wall segment。如果你看着我心想，什么是 wall segment？别担心。你可以从概念上把它理解为数据库中目前已变更的数据量。

cues.en: Or a time out. An actual number of wall clock minutes is timed out.
cues.zh: 或者超时。实际经过的 wall clock 分钟数达到超时。

cues.en: Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 不幸的是，

cues.en: for the purposes of people trying to teach this like me,
cues.zh: 对于像我这样试图教授这门课的人来说，

cues.en: there was a big change to how this worked in nine five. So I'm gonna give you both... Who's on nine four or earlier?
cues.zh: 在 9.5 中，这个机制发生了很大变化。所以我会把两种都讲一下……谁用的是 9.4 或更早版本？

cues.en: Who's running Postgres?
cues.zh: 谁在用 Postgres？

cues.en: Who's on nine point five and later?
cues.zh: 谁在用 9.5 或更新版本？

cues.en: Wow.
cues.zh: 哇。

cues.en: Good good adoption. Yay. I have people who are running on eight point two.
cues.zh: 版本升级得不错，太好了！还有人在用 8.2。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: you can sleep through the nine point four stuff, but... Or in case you have to maintain a system.
cues.zh: 你可以不用管 9.4 的那些内容，好好睡觉……不过，如果你得维护系统，那就另说了。

cues.en: On nine four and earlier,
cues.zh: 在 9.4 及更早的版本里，

cues.en: we set...
cues.zh: 我们设置……

cues.en: These aren't chain... These don't change between nine four and nine five. Set wall buffer is 16 megabytes, checkpoint completion target to 0.9,
cues.zh: 这些参数在 9.4 和 9.5 之间没有变化。shared_buffers 设为 16 MB，checkpoint_completion_target 设为 0.9，

cues.en: checkpoint timeouts between ten minutes and thirty minutes.
cues.zh: checkpoint_timeout 设为 10 到 30 分钟。

cues.en: Higher is better performance,
cues.zh: 数值越高，性能越好，

cues.en: but Postgres will take more time restarting
cues.zh: 但数值越高，

cues.en: with a higher number.
cues.zh: Postgres 重启耗时就越长。

cues.en: Generally, you should anticipate Postgres will take about 20% of this number to start from a crash.
cues.zh: 一般来说，你需要预估 Postgres 崩溃恢复大约需要这个时长的 20%。

cues.en: Not from a clean restart, just from a crash.
cues.zh: 不是正常重启，仅指崩溃恢复。

cues.en: So if you set it to ten minutes, Postgres could take up to two minutes to start back up. And if you set it to thirty minutes, it could take up to six minutes. So let your conscience and business process be your guide to what you set this to. Higher is general better performance.
cues.zh: 所以设为 10 分钟的话，Postgres 重启最多需要 2 分钟；设为 30 分钟，可能就要长达 6 分钟。具体设为多少，取决于你的心理承受力和业务流程。通常来说，数值越高，性能越好。

cues.en: Then on 9.4,
cues.zh: 然后在 9.4 中，

cues.en: we pick a particular number of checkpoint segments and say, If
cues.zh: 我们选定一个特定的检查点段数，然后说，如果

cues.en: you've written 13 wall
cues.zh: 你已经写了 13 个 WAL

cues.en: segments, do a checkpoint.
cues.zh: 段，就做一个检查点。

cues.en: These don't change in 9.5,
cues.zh: 这些在 9.5 中没有变化，

cues.en: but we get two new ones,
cues.zh: 但我们有两个新的参数，

cues.en: and checkpoint segments went away.
cues.zh: 而检查点段数这个参数被移除了。

cues.en: we actually specify
cues.zh: 我们实际上指定了

cues.en: how much write ahead log information to keep around, a minimum and a maximum.
cues.zh: 要保留多少预写日志信息，一个最小值和一个最大值。

cues.en: And the actual amount of disk it uses kind of drifts between these two depending on system activity. It will try and keep... It will always keep at least this much around,
cues.zh: 而它实际使用的磁盘量会在这两者之间浮动，取决于系统活动。它会尝试保持……它始终会保留至少这么多，

cues.en: and it'll try to never keep more than that amount around. Because one thing's about a checkpoint is when a checkpoint occurs, it can throw away old wall information because it doesn't need it anymore.
cues.zh: 并且会尽量不超过那个上限。因为检查点的一个特点是，当检查点发生时，它可以丢弃旧的 WAL 信息，因为不再需要了。

cues.en: This will make more sense later.
cues.zh: 这样以后你就更容易理解了。

cues.en: So how you tune this on nine four is
cues.zh: 所以在九四版本上调优时，

cues.en: you look for the... You've you've picked all this stuff and you've set all the parameters, and now you start up the system and you're looking at the logs.
cues.zh: 你要看……你已经把这些东西都选好了，也设置了所有参数。现在启动系统，查看日志。

cues.en: And you say, okay, and every time Postgres does a checkpoint because you turned on log checkpoints,
cues.zh: 你会发现，每次 Postgres 执行检查点时，因为你开启了检查点日志，

cues.en: it'll tell you, I did a checkpoint.
cues.zh: 它都会告诉你：我执行了一次检查点。

cues.en: And you look at it and say, are they happening more often than checkpoint
cues.zh: 你看着日志，问自己：检查点发生的频率是不是高于检查点

cues.en: timeout? Did I set checkpoint timeout to fifteen minutes, but they're happening every five minutes?
cues.zh: 超时时间？我把检查点超时设成了十五分钟，可它们每五分钟就发生一次？

cues.en: If that's true, you just keep bumping up checkpoint segments until that's not true anymore. And by bump up, I mean double.
cues.zh: 如果是这样，你就一直调大 checkpoint segments，直到不再触发这种情况。我说的调大，是指翻倍。

cues.en: So if it's set to... Checkpoint segments was set to 32 megabytes... Or 32. Excuse me. It's just a count.
cues.zh: 所以如果它设的是……checkpoint segments 之前设的是 32 兆……不对，是 32。抱歉，它只是个计数。

cues.en: And checkpoints are happening every five minutes. You go to 64.
cues.zh: 此时检查点每 5 分钟发生一次。你就调到 64。

cues.en: Now they go ten minutes. You go to one twenty eight. Now they're going every twenty minutes, and you're done.
cues.zh: 现在变成 10 分钟一次了。你再调到 128。现在变成每 20 分钟一次，这就搞定了。

cues.en: So that's all you had to do on 09/04 and earlier.
cues.zh: 在 9.4 及更早版本里，你要做的就只有这些。

cues.en: Nine point five is a lot like this, only we have these two new parameters. And so it's a little bit more tricky.
cues.zh: 9.5 和这个很相似，只是我们有了这两个新参数。所以会稍微棘手一点。

cues.en: Basically,
cues.zh: 基本上，

cues.en: you bump up wall... Min wall... You... If they're happening too frequently,
cues.zh: 你调高 WAL……最小 WAL……你……如果它们发生得太频繁，

cues.en: the step one is you bump up min wall size
cues.zh: 第一步就是调高最小 WAL 大小

cues.en: so that they're
cues.zh: 这样它们

cues.en: happening less frequently than the timeout. So for example,
cues.zh: 发生的频率就会低于超时时间。举个例子，

cues.en: you set checkpoint timeout to ten minutes,
cues.zh: 你把检查点超时设为十分钟，

cues.en: and you set min wall size
cues.zh: 然后把最小 WAL 大小

cues.en: to a 512
cues.zh: 设为 512

cues.en: megabytes, and they're happening every five minutes. You go, okay. I'm gonna keep a gigabyte of wall information on minimal size, and so you double it or something like that.
cues.zh: 兆字节，而它们每五分钟就发生一次。你说，好吧。我要在最小大小下保留一吉字节的 WAL 信息，于是你把它翻倍或者类似的做法。

cues.en: And that... And eventually, you'll get... And, you know, you'll iterate on this a few times,
cues.zh: 然后……最后你会……你知道，你会在这上面迭代几次，

cues.en: and now they're happening every
cues.zh: 现在它们每隔

cues.en: seventeen minutes and that's good and so you're done.
cues.zh: 十七分钟发生一次，这就很好，所以你搞定了。

cues.en: Again,
cues.zh: 再说一次，

cues.en: higher is better for performance purposes
cues.zh: 从性能角度看，数值越高越好，

cues.en: because
cues.zh: 因为

cues.en: it doesn't have to do checkpoints as frequently. But the less often checkpoints happen,
cues.zh: 这样就不用那么频繁地创建检查点了。但检查点间隔越长，

cues.en: the longer Postgres will take to start up on a crash and the more disk space it'll use, but disk space is really cheap.
cues.zh: Postgres 在崩溃后启动所需的时间就越长，占用的磁盘空间也越多，不过磁盘空间很便宜。

cues.en: And then
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: when... Anytime you bump up min wall size, you generally wanna set max wall size to be about three times min wall size.
cues.zh: 当……任何时候调大 min_wal_size，通常最好把 max_wal_size 设为它的三倍左右。

cues.en: You can set it to more than three times if you have the disk
cues.zh: 如果磁盘空间足够，你也可以设到三倍以上，

cues.en: and you you want some performance improvement. Once those are all set, you're done.
cues.zh: 并且你还想要进一步提升性能。一旦这些都配好了，就搞定了。

cues.en: Did that make sense?
cues.zh: 听懂了吗？

cues.en: That's an ambiguous response from the audience.
cues.zh: 大家的反应有点模棱两可啊。

cues.en: We'll talk more about the write ahead log. And if if... Once we've talked about that, this is still unclear, by all means, ask questions.
cues.zh: 我们稍后还会详细聊写前日志（WAL）。如果……等讲完之后还是不清楚，大家尽管提问。

cues.en: One thing to remember is a nine nine point four and earlier,
cues.zh: 要记住的一点是，在 9.9.4 及更早版本中，

cues.en: the wall can take up to three times 16 megabytes times the number of checkpoint segments.
cues.zh: WAL 最多可占用 16 MB 的三倍乘以检查点段数。

cues.en: So the higher you bump up checkpoint segments, the more disk space the wall could potentially take.
cues.zh: 所以你把检查点段数调得越高，WAL 可能占用的磁盘空间就越多。

cues.en: 9.5 and later, you... You're calling out exactly how much disk space you want to allocate to the wall, and it'll drift between those two numbers depending on system activity.
cues.zh: 9.5 及以后版本中，你……你可以精确指定想给 WAL 分配多少磁盘空间，它会根据系统活动在这两个数值之间浮动。

cues.en: Restarting from a crash potentially can, on a very, very highly loaded write intensive system, take up to checkpoint time out.
cues.zh: 从崩溃中重启，在负载极高、写入密集的系统上，可能最多需要一个检查点超时时间。

cues.en: So if you set it to thirty minutes and your system's being pounded by writes...
cues.zh: 所以，如果你把它设为 30 分钟，而系统一直承受大量写入……

cues.en: And, again, this is nearly a pathology, but it can happen.
cues.zh: 再说一次，这几乎算是一种极端情况，但确实可能发生。

cues.en: Restarting the system could take thirty minutes.
cues.zh: 系统重启可能需要 30 分钟。

cues.en: This doesn't happen very often,
cues.zh: 这种情况不太常见，

cues.en: and I usually
cues.zh: 我通常

cues.en: tell people to anticipate more like 20%
cues.zh: 会告诉大家，按检查点超时时间的 20% 左右来预估

cues.en: of checkpoint time out. But just remember that the higher you that if you set this to four hours, what you may be
cues.zh: 就行。但要记住，如果你把它设为 4 小时，重启时可能会

cues.en: in store for on a restart.
cues.zh: 需要这么久。

cues.en: But higher is better for performance purposes.
cues.zh: 但从性能角度来看，越高越好。

cues.en: Okay, and now you're done with Check Point settings.
cues.zh: 好的，检查点设置到这里就讲完了。

cues.en: Planner settings.
cues.zh: 接下来是规划器设置。

cues.en: There are only a few that you have to... That are worth changing. There's effective IO concurrency.
cues.zh: 只有少数几个……值得修改的参数。比如 effective_io_concurrency。

cues.en: If you know how many IO channels you have,
cues.zh: 如果你清楚自己有多少个 IO 通道，

cues.en: you set it to that. For example, on your typical RAID RAID 10 system with two... With four disks, you have four IO channels,
cues.zh: 就设为那个数值。比如典型的 4 盘 RAID 10 系统，

cues.en: basically. How many IO operations can you have going simultaneously?
cues.zh: 基本上就有 4 个 IO 通道。也就是你能同时执行多少个 IO 操作？

cues.en: Most SSDs are units of 16. They're either sixteen thirty two or 64.
cues.zh: 大多数固态硬盘的单元大小是 16。要么是 16、32，要么是 64。

cues.en: So you can set it to that.
cues.zh: 所以你可以把它设成那个值。

cues.en: SANs
cues.zh: SAN

cues.en: depends on what kind of infrastructure you have. If you don't know,
cues.zh: 取决于你用的是哪种基础设施。如果你不清楚，

cues.en: don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 就别管它。

cues.en: The other one is random page cost. By default, this is 4.0,
cues.zh: 另一个是随机页面成本。默认是 4.0，

cues.en: which is almost always too high on any real life system these days.
cues.zh: 这在如今任何真实系统上都几乎总是太高了。

cues.en: What random page cost is, is it's the ratio for planning purposes of how long it takes to fetch a random page off of storage.
cues.zh: 随机页面成本指的是，在规划时用来估算从存储中随机取一个页面需要多长时间的比值。

cues.en: Excuse me, voices.
cues.zh: 抱歉，声音有点哑。

cues.en: A little hoarse
cues.zh: 有点沙哑

cues.en: versus
cues.zh: 相比之下

cues.en: how long it takes to
cues.zh: 获取一个顺序页面

cues.en: fetch a sequential page.
cues.zh: 需要多长时间。

cues.en: It's a
cues.zh: 这是个

cues.en: wild ass guess, so don't worry too much about it. Like on a typical Ray 10 and wait... Ray three is a kind of good number.
cues.zh: 纯粹瞎猜，所以别太当真。比如，典型的 Ray 10，等等……Ray 3 算是个不错的数。

cues.en: If you're running on SAN and most virtualized environments like Rackspace, two is a good number.
cues.zh: 如果你用的是 SAN，或者 Rackspace 这类虚拟化环境，2 是个不错的数。

cues.en: If you're running on EBS on Amazon, 1.1
cues.zh: 如果你在 Amazon 上用的是 EBS，1.1

cues.en: is a good number because there's no such thing as a sequential page fetch on EBS. Everything was basically random because you're sharing with so many other people.
cues.zh: 就是个不错的数，因为 EBS 上不存在顺序页面读取这种事。基本上所有读取都是随机的，因为你和很多其他人共用资源。

cues.en: But that's it. Those are the only two settings you have to change.
cues.zh: 但也就这样了，你只需要改这两个设置。

cues.en: At this point, you are done with postgresql.conf.
cues.zh: 到这里，postgresql.conf 就算配置完了。

cues.en: So that wasn't too bad, actually.
cues.zh: 其实没那么难，对吧？

cues.en: You know? Configure your production per database system, and you're done.
cues.zh: 按每个数据库系统去配置你的生产环境，搞定。

cues.en: So there's a couple things never ever to touch. One of them is f sync.
cues.zh: 不过有几样东西千万千万别动，其中之一就是 fsync。

cues.en: Never turn off f sync. You will get database corruption with FSync off.
cues.zh: 绝不要关掉 fsync，关掉它会导致数据库损坏。

cues.en: Just don't.
cues.zh: 千万别动。

cues.en: There's one that you... That's a little bit less of a stern admonition,
cues.zh: 还有一个……语气可以稍微不用那么严厉的，

cues.en: which is synchronous
cues.zh: 就是 synchronous

cues.en: commit.
cues.zh: commit。

cues.en: You can turn off synchronous commit and you will probably see a throughput boost,
cues.zh: 你可以关闭同步提交，吞吐量大概率会提升，

cues.en: but you have to understand what it does.
cues.zh: 但你得明白它在做什么。

cues.en: So let's talk about what it does.
cues.zh: 那我们来聊聊它到底做了什么。

cues.en: By default,

cues.en: So a crash won't cause it... Will never cause it to go away.

cues.en: but you get control back right away, even though the data hasn't been written.
cues.zh: 但即使数据还没写入，你也会立刻拿回控制权。

cues.en: So if the database... There is a window in which the database could crash and that transaction you just committed isn't there when the database starts back up again. The data is not... The database isn't corrupt

cues.en: you're back in time for where you thought you were, and there's some missing data.

cues.en: So we're gonna talk the write ahead log.

cues.en: Because I I
cues.zh: 因为我，我

cues.en: sort of hand wavelengthy said, tune this write ahead log stuff and do this write ahead log stuff. But it's important if you're administering Postgres... And if you're just a Postgres user, you never even hear about the write ahead log. Stuff just works.
cues.zh: 之前只是大概说了说，要调好预写日志、处理好预写日志。但如果你在管理 Postgres，这些就很重要……如果你只是 Postgres 用户，甚至都不会听说预写日志，一切照常运行。

cues.en: It's an implementation technology.
cues.zh: 这是一种底层实现技术。

cues.en: But if you're you're administering the system, you kinda need to understand it because a huge amount of stuff in Postgres is based on the write ahead log.
cues.zh: 但如果你负责管理系统，就多少得了解它，因为 Postgres 中大量的机制都是基于预写日志（WAL）的。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: It's really key to a lot of Postgres operations,
cues.zh: 它对 Postgres 的许多操作都至关重要，

cues.en: like replication,
cues.zh: 比如复制，

cues.en: like crash recovery, all sorts of stuff.
cues.zh: 比如崩溃恢复，以及各种各样的功能。

cues.en: You don't have to worry too much about the internals of it, like what the file format and stuff like that is. I don't remember what the file format is. But
cues.zh: 你不需要对其内部细节过于操心，比如具体的文件格式之类的。我自己都不记得文件格式是什么。但是，

cues.en: it is a good idea to understand what it is and why we need it.
cues.zh: 搞清楚它是什么、我们为什么需要它，是很有必要的。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: whenever whenever you finish a transaction, you say commit,
cues.zh: 每次你完成一个事务，就说 commit，

cues.en: Postgres doesn't take that data and shove it into the main database structure.
cues.zh: Postgres 不会把这些数据塞进主数据库结构里。

cues.en: If it did that, the system would grind to a halt.
cues.zh: 要是这么做，系统就会慢得动不了。

cues.en: The performance would be terrible.
cues.zh: 性能会非常差。

cues.en: What it does do is take what you've changed
cues.zh: 它会把你做的更改

cues.en: and write it to a single file, which is called the write ahead log. Conceptually, you can think of this as an infinitely long
cues.zh: 写入一个单独的文件，叫作预写日志。你可以把它想象成一份无限长的

cues.en: history of changes.
cues.zh: 变更历史。

cues.en: The reason we need this is if the system crashes,
cues.zh: 我们需要这个的原因是，一旦系统崩溃，

cues.en: we go back to the write ahead log and replay those changes so we bring the sys... Database up to consistent state again.
cues.zh: 我们就能回到预写日志并重放这些变更，从而让系……数据库恢复到一致状态。

cues.en: Every database in the world pretty much uses a write ahead log.
cues.zh: 世界上几乎每种数据库都会使用预写日志。

cues.en: This is not a Postgres specific thing. They all implement it differently, the write
cues.zh: 这并不是 Postgres 独有的。虽然它们实现各有不同，但预写

cues.en: ahead log technology is decades
cues.zh: 日志技术已经有几十年的

cues.en: old.
cues.zh: 历史了。

cues.en: It's a continuous record of changes since the last checkpoint.
cues.zh: 它是自上一个检查点以来变更的连续记录。

cues.en: Conceptually, you could imagine, well, what if we just initialized Postgres,
cues.zh: 从概念上说，你可以想象一下：要是我们初始化了 Postgres，

cues.en: started operations,
cues.zh: 开始执行操作，

cues.en: and never did a checkpoint
cues.zh: 然后从来不做检查点

cues.en: ever.
cues.zh: 会怎么样。

cues.en: And we just kept... And the write ahead logs just kept building and building and building and building.
cues.zh: 日志就会一直……预写日志会越积越多，越来越多。

cues.en: That would actually work.
cues.zh: 这样其实也能运行。

cues.en: The problem is
cues.zh: 问题是，

cues.en: you wouldn't like crash recovery very much if you'd been running the system for three years and it had to replay three years' worth of wall records.
cues.zh: 如果系统已经运行了三年，崩溃恢复时还得重放三年的 WAL 记录，你肯定不会喜欢。

cues.en: So we checkpoint. And what happens on a checkpoint is
cues.zh: 所以我们进行检查点（checkpoint）操作。而检查点发生时

cues.en: that...
cues.zh: 实际上……

cues.en: Let's back up... Is it
cues.zh: 我们往回退一点……它实际上

cues.en: effectively snips the wall
cues.zh: 直接截断了 WAL

cues.en: and throws away everything before
cues.zh: 并把检查点之前的所有内容

cues.en: the checkpoint.
cues.zh: 都丢弃掉。

cues.en: And now when we could do a crash recovery, we only... We just start at the checkpoint because we know we know at the checkpoint... At the moment of the checkpoint, the disc image was completely consistent,
cues.zh: 现在当我们需要做崩溃恢复时，我们只需要……直接从检查点开始就行，因为我们知道……在做检查点的那一刻，磁盘镜像的状态是完全一致的，

cues.en: And it's okay to keep going from there.
cues.zh: 从那里继续运行完全没问题。

cues.en: So if you have a disk image of the database and every wall that was created... Record that was created since then, you can recreate the database at the end of the write ahead log.
cues.zh: 所以，如果你有数据库的磁盘映像，以及此后创建的每条记录，就能在预写式日志的末尾重建数据库。

cues.en: And this is how Postgres does crash recovery.
cues.zh: 这就是 Postgres 进行崩溃恢复的方式。

cues.en: In this
cues.zh: 在这个

cues.en: magic directory p g x log is where the transaction log is actually stored. Again, just like everything on Postgres, these are just files. It's broken into 16 megabyte segments.
cues.zh: 神奇的目录 pg_xlog 里，实际存放着事务日志。再说一次，Postgres 里的一切都只是文件。日志被分成每段 16 MB。

cues.en: And, again, never mess with it. Don't delete anything out of it. Feel free to look at it. You'll see a bunch of files with these giant hexadecimal file names. It's kinda boring.
cues.zh: 再说一次，千万别去乱动它。不要删里面的任何东西。你可以随便看，会看到一堆带着长长十六进制文件名的文件，挺无聊的。

cues.en: But
cues.zh: 但是

cues.en: Postgres automatically manages the size of this directory. It'll recycle these segments when they don't need need them anymore, either by deleting them or re... Or renaming them to be new segments.
cues.zh: Postgres 会自动管理这个目录的大小。当不再需要这些段文件时，它会自动回收，要么直接删除，要么……要么重命名为新的段文件。

cues.en: So that's pretty cool, and that's how we do crash recovery.
cues.zh: 所以这招挺牛的，我们也就是通过这种方式来实现崩溃恢复的。

cues.en: And it works great. Now,
cues.zh: 而且效果很好。现在，

cues.en: there's also a command in Postgres, in the Postgres global account called archive command.
cues.zh: Postgres 还有一条命令，配置在 Postgres 的全局设置里，叫作归档命令。

cues.en: Every time it finishes a wall segment, so every time it completes one of these 16 megabyte segments,
cues.zh: 每当它完成一个 WAL 段，也就是每当它写满一个 16 MB 的段，

cues.en: it runs the command specified in archive command.
cues.zh: 就会运行归档命令里指定的命令。

cues.en: So why would it do that?
cues.zh: 它为什么要这么做呢？

cues.en: The command itself can do whatever you want,
cues.zh: 这条命令可以执行任何操作，

cues.en: but the nice part with what you want it to do is move this wall someplace safe,
cues.zh: 不过理想情况下，它应该把 WAL 文件移到安全的地方，

cues.en: like to a different system.
cues.zh: 比如另一台机器上。

cues.en: Well, why would you want to do that?
cues.zh: 那么，为什么要这么做呢？

cues.en: And we'll talk about why you want to do that in a sec.
cues.zh: 我们稍后就会讨论为什么要这样做。

cues.en: So when Postgres restarts, it replays the wall to bring it back to a consistent state.
cues.zh: 所以当 Postgres 重启时，它会重放 WAL，使其恢复到一致状态。

cues.en: And you have to have the wall segments for
cues.zh: 而且你必须保留这些 WAL 段，

cues.en: proper crash recovery.
cues.zh: 才能实现正确的崩溃恢复。

cues.en: And again, the longer it's been since the last crash,
cues.zh: 同样，距离上一次崩溃的时间越长——

cues.en: the more since the last checkpoint, the more wall it has to process, so the longer the whole process takes.
cues.zh: 准确说是距离上次检查点越久，它需要处理的 WAL 就越多，整个过程也就耗时越长。

cues.en: And again,
cues.zh: 再说一遍，

cues.en: this is what synchronous commit does.
cues.zh: 这就是同步提交的作用。

cues.en: So you you... If you have synchronous commit off, you might lose transactions on a crash because your wall... Because
cues.zh: 所以，如果你关闭了同步提交，发生崩溃时可能会丢失事务，因为你的墙……因为

cues.en: there's stuff that you've committed,
cues.zh: 有些内容已经提交了，

cues.en: but it hasn't been written to the wall yet. But, again, there's no danger of database corruption.
cues.zh: 但还没写到墙上。不过数据库不会因此损坏。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's the write ahead log. The reason we talk about that is because we... The next big topic is backup and recovery, and the write ahead log provides a lot of tools for doing backup and recovery.
cues.zh: 这就是预写式日志。我们谈它的原因是……接下来一个重要主题是备份与恢复，而预写式日志为备份与恢复提供了很多工具。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: If you have a small database and you're just getting started, the tool that everyone knows or, you know, first gets involved with is called pgdump.
cues.zh: 如果你的数据库规模较小，而且刚起步，大家最熟悉、最先接触到的工具就是 pg_dump。

cues.en: It's a command line tool, chips with Postgres.
cues.zh: 它是一个命令行工具，随 Postgres 一起自带。

cues.en: It it takes a logical snapshot of the database at the moment it connects.
cues.zh: 它会在连接数据库的那一刻，生成一份逻辑快照。

cues.en: So the good part about it is you don't have to shut the database down.
cues.zh: 它的优点在于，你不需要停机维护。

cues.en: You don't have to
cues.zh: 你不需要……

cues.en: you don't have to stop writes. There's no magic backup mode that it puts the database in or anything like that. It connects
cues.zh: 你不需要停止写入。它不会把数据库置于某种特殊的备份模式，或者搞什么复杂操作。它直接连接

cues.en: the database
cues.zh: 数据库，

cues.en: and copies all the data out, and it's perfectly logically consistent
cues.zh: 然后把所有数据复制出来，而且在逻辑上完全保持一致，

cues.en: as of the moment it connected to the database.
cues.zh: 严格对应连接到数据库的那一瞬间。

cues.en: So basically, can... You know, there's a... Database has a... You know, it's commit, commit, commit, commit, commit. The
cues.zh: 所以基本上，可以……你知道，有一个……数据库里有……你知道，提交、提交、提交、提交、提交。那个

cues.en: pgdump connects everything that was committed before that connection gets recorded. Nothing that is committed after that connection gets recorded.
cues.zh: pgdump 会连接数据库，并记录连接建立前已提交的所有内容。连接建立后提交的内容都不会被记录。

cues.en: So it's logically consistent.
cues.zh: 所以逻辑上是一致的。

cues.en: But that means everything that happens to the database while pgdump is running is not going to be recorded in that dump file.
cues.zh: 但这意味着，pgdump 运行期间数据库里发生的所有变化，都不会记录到那个转储文件中。

cues.en: That make sense?
cues.zh: 能理解吗？

cues.en: Nice part about this is it doesn't lock the database in any way, and it doesn't prevent writes to disk.
cues.zh: 这么做的好处是完全不会锁数据库，也不会阻止写入磁盘。

cues.en: It's relatively low overhead, but not zero, because it is having to copy every single thing off the database.
cues.zh: 它的开销相对较低，但并不是零，毕竟它必须把数据库里的所有东西都复制一份。

cues.en: And it's it's very... The... It has a lot of virtues. You get this one big file
cues.zh: 而且它非常……它有很多优点。你会得到这样一个大文件，

cues.en: which... That's easy to manage. You know, copying it to someplace else is not not complicated.
cues.zh: 这非常容易管理。你想把它复制到别的地方，操作一点也不复杂。

cues.en: It's very easy to use. Single command line. No fuss.
cues.zh: 用起来很简单。一条命令就行，毫不费事。

cues.en: It does, however, have some downsides.
cues.zh: 不过，它也有一些缺点。

cues.en: The command that you use to restore a database... Oh, the other nice part about it is you can be very selective about what you back up. You can exclude particular database objects like schemas and tables.
cues.zh: 用来恢复数据库的命令……哦，它另一个方便之处是，你可以很灵活地选择备份内容。可以排除特定的数据库对象，比如模式和表。

cues.en: You can just back up a single table with it if you want. It has a lot of control.
cues.zh: 如果愿意，你甚至可以只备份一张表。它提供了很多控制选项。

cues.en: So that's all really nice stuff about it.
cues.zh: 这些功能都很不错。

cues.en: The reverse
cues.zh: 相反的

cues.en: command is called pg restore,
cues.zh: 命令叫做 pg_restore，

cues.en: which restores a database from a pg dump.
cues.zh: 它用来从 pg_dump 中恢复数据库。

cues.en: The biggest problem here is this isn't really fast. It can take a long time to do a pg restore.
cues.zh: 这里最大的问题是速度并不快，执行 pg_restore 可能会花很长时间。

cues.en: Pg dump, for example,
cues.zh: 比如 pg_dump

cues.en: does not dump indexes.
cues.zh: 并不会转储索引。

cues.en: It dumps their definitions, but it doesn't dump the data that's in the index itself. So PG restore has to rebuild all those indexes.
cues.zh: 它会导出索引的定义，但不会导出索引本身包含的数据。所以 pg_restore 必须重建所有这些索引。

cues.en: That could take a long time.
cues.zh: 这可能会耗费大量时间。

cues.en: So it's great for a simple backup,
cues.zh: 所以做简单备份它很不错，

cues.en: but you're not... But it's really not suitable for fast recovery from a major failure.
cues.zh: 但你不能……但它确实不适合在发生重大故障时进行快速恢复。

cues.en: You know, if you're... If if you... The system goes down and you need to get back up in the next three minutes because you're losing money, p g restore is not gonna be what you want unless you have a really tiny database that you can p g restore in three minutes.
cues.zh: 你知道，如果你……如果，如果你……系统宕机了，你得在接下来三分钟内恢复服务，因为每分钟都在亏钱，那 p g restore 就不是你想要的方案，除非你的数据库特别小，能在三分钟内用 p g restore 恢复。

cues.en: One other interesting
cues.zh: 另一个有意思的

cues.en: characteristic is p g dump works database by database. And remember, there can be multiple databases inside of a cluster.
cues.zh: 特点是，p g dump 是按数据库逐个工作的。别忘了，一个集群里可以有多个数据库。

cues.en: For most environments, there's one big database that has all the real data in it, but that's not always true.
cues.zh: 对大多数环境来说，通常都有一个存了所有真实数据的大数据库，但也并不总是这样。

cues.en: Also,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: some things that are in the database, like users and roles, are not specific to a particular database, but they're global across the whole cluster.
cues.zh: 数据库里的某些内容（比如用户和角色）并不归属于某个特定的数据库，而是在整个集群级别全局生效的。

cues.en: To back those up, you need a separate command
cues.zh: 要备份这些内容，你需要一条单独的命令，

cues.en: called p g dump all dash dash globals all... Globals only. Excuse me. So you need to do two so you actually need to do two things, which is kind of annoying.
cues.zh: 也就是 pg_dumpall --globals-all... 抱歉，是 --globals-only。所以你其实得做两件事，这确实有点烦人。

cues.en: And then you can back up each database.
cues.zh: 然后你就可以分别备份每个数据库。

cues.en: By
cues.zh: 由

cues.en: default, pgdump writes
cues.zh: 默认情况下，pgdump 会写入

cues.en: a giant SQL file,
cues.zh: 一个巨大的 SQL 文件，

cues.en: which is kind of cool, you know, if you wanna move to another database or something like that. But most of the time, you're just trying to get a compact dump that you can restore into a Postgres database. For that, use format equals custom.
cues.zh: 这挺酷的，比如你想迁移到另一个数据库之类的。不过大多数时候，你只是想要一份精简的转储文件，之后可以还原到 Postgres 数据库里。这种情况下，用 format 等于 custom。

cues.en: That dumps a compact binary but portable format for Postgres.
cues.zh: 它会导出一种紧凑、可移植的 Postgres 二进制格式。

cues.en: The other big advantage of doing a restoring custom format is you can do what's called a parallel restore
cues.zh: 采用自定义格式进行备份还有一个很大的好处：可以进行所谓的并行恢复

cues.en: on pg restore
cues.zh: 在 pg_restore 上

cues.en: where it will, like,
cues.zh: 它就会，呃，直接……

cues.en: restore multiple tables and multiple indexes in parallel. And that could be speed up... Speed things up quite a bit, but you need custom format to do that.
cues.zh: 并行恢复多张表和多个索引。这样可以……大幅提升速度，但需要使用自定义格式。

cues.en: If you use the dash dash jobs option on p g restore, that turns on parallel restore.
cues.zh: 如果在 pg_restore 中使用 --jobs 选项，就会开启并行恢复。

cues.en: You generally wanna set to number of cores or execution threads, whatever you wanna call them, in your system plus one.
cues.zh: 通常建议将其设置为系统核心数或执行线程数（随你怎么叫）再加一。

cues.en: So if it's an eight core machine, set it to nine.
cues.zh: 所以如果是 8 核机器，就设成 9。

cues.en: Most of the time, on a big database, you're going be spent restoring indexes
cues.zh: 对于大型数据库，大部分时间都会花在恢复索引上，

cues.en: and setting jobs equals to whatever will parallelize that operation. And again, restores are not fast.
cues.zh: 而设置 jobs 参数就能让这个操作并行化。再次强调，恢复数据并不快。

cues.en: They're not great for disaster recovery where you're trying to get back online quickly.
cues.zh: 它们不太适合灾难恢复，因为这种情况下你得尽快恢复上线。

cues.en: So in that case... And, you know... And also, this is this is copying the entire database into a giant file. If you have an 18 terabyte database,
cues.zh: 所以这种情况下……你知道……而且，这会把整个数据库复制到一个巨大的文件里。如果你的数据库有 18 TB，

cues.en: probably you're not wild about this idea of creating with this one giant file
cues.zh: 你大概不会喜欢把它做成一个巨大文件的这种方案，

cues.en: that will take two weeks to restore.
cues.zh: 因为恢复这个文件要花两周。

cues.en: That... You know, I I wouldn't wanna try and sell that to my business owners
cues.zh: 这个……你知道，我可不想把这种方案推销给业务负责人，

cues.en: about the way to handle backup.
cues.zh: 说这是处理备份的办法。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: what do we do? Well,
cues.zh: 我们该怎么做呢？

cues.zh: 假设我们对数据目录做了一次快照。所谓快照，我指的是用 rsync 这种文件系统级别的拷贝。没什么玄机，说到底就是些文件。然后我们把这些文件传输出去。

There's partial changes. You have this horrible corrupt database that you just you just did a snapshot of. What possible use is this garbage? And the answer is you're absolutely right.
cues.zh: 你们……在座的程序员可能会说，这太疯狂了，因为数据库还在满负荷运行。它在写入，但并没有写入所有内容。存在部分变更。你刚对一个严重损坏的数据库做了快照。这堆垃圾能有什么用？答案是，你说得完全对。

cues.zh: 就能让那个快照

cues.en: up to consistency
cues.zh: 达到一致状态

cues.zh: 继续之前，这样说得通吗？

cues.zh: 所以你你你

cues.zh: 开始

cues.zh: 记录 WAL。现在你有了 WAL，然后你说，好，我们来同步。然后你

cues.en: copy the entire database over and stop.
cues.zh: 把整个数据库复制过去，然后停下来。

cues.zh: 转到另一台机器上，你说，好，我要用刚才复制的那个镜像。

cues.zh: 我要启动 Postgres，然后说，好，Postgres，启动。

cues.zh: Postgres 启动后会说：

cues.en: looks like it crashed to me. Oh, there's the wall.
cues.zh: 在我看来，它好像崩溃了。哦，WAL 在这儿。

cues.en: Replay the wall to the end, and now you have a completely consistent database as of the lost wall record.
cues.zh: 把日志重放到末尾，就能得到一个完全一致的数据库，状态对应于丢失的那条日志记录。

cues.en: It sounds almost magical, but it works great. It's exactly like crash recovery.
cues.zh: 这听起来几乎像魔法，但效果很好。它和崩溃恢复完全一样。

cues.en: And note...
cues.zh: 请注意……

cues.en: And notice that the only thing we had to do is replay the wall, which is a lot faster than doing a PG restore.
cues.zh: 注意，我们唯一要做的就是重放日志，这比执行 PostgreSQL 恢复快得多。

cues.en: So, okay, this is starting to sound pretty good.
cues.zh: 好吧，这听起来已经挺不错了。

cues.zh: 所以我们需要……首先，得有个地方存放所有这些日志备份……这些日志段，以及这个……巨大的文件系统备份，

cues.zh: 我说……我向他们指出了这一点，他们说，对，对，对，我们知道，傻了吧唧的顾问，我们没那么蠢。我说，行吧行吧，不好意思，我不是那个意思。那你们的备用……容灾服务器在哪？在西奥克兰 Digital Realty 的机房里，

cues.zh: 处于恢复模式运行。每次它收到新的 WAL……它就守在那儿，等着 WAL 段呼啸而来，然后戴好手套接住。WAL 段一到，它就应用到本地数据库上。

cues.en: SCP creates the filename initially, and Postgres could get really unhappy if it looks for the wall segment, picks it up, and discovers it's only half done.

cues.en: So use either our sync. Wally has tools to do this also.

cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: what if... And, you know, because we could lose data, because we could be halfway through a 16... One of these 16 megabyte wall segments, The system goes down. It hasn't been archived yet,
cues.zh: 如果……你知道，我们可能会丢数据。比如一个 16……这些 16 MB 的 WAL 段还写到一半，系统就宕机了。它还没归档，

cues.en: without having to ship the file? So every transaction that gets... Every time there's a commit, we just ship the data straight on over. That's a great idea. And it's such a great idea, in fact, Postgres implements it. And that's what streaming replication is.
cues.zh: 而无需传输文件？所以每个事务……每次提交时，我们就把数据直接传过去。这是个好主意。事实上，这主意太好了，Postgres 就实现了它。这就是流复制。

cues.en: So it's the same basic technology
cues.zh: 所以它和崩溃恢复用的是同样的基础技术

cues.en: as crash recovery, as wall archiving, as any of these, except instead of having to go through the wall segment, wall segment, wall segment, it just... There's just a TCP IP connection that ships the data down to the secondary directly.
cues.zh: 和 WAL 归档等技术一样，只不过不必再经过 WAL 段、WAL 段、WAL 段，而是……只需一条 TCP IP 连接，把数据直接传到从库。

cues.en: So the way stream replication works is the the secondary wakes... Connects to the primary.

cues.zh: 在
